newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanwha targets '97 sales at 2.7 trln won.
newsitem.headline: Hanwha targets '97 sales at 2.7 trln won.

text.p: South Korea's Hanwha Energy Co Ltd said on Thursday it has set its 1997 turnover target at 2.7 trillion won, up 11 percent from an estimated 2.43 trillion won last year.
Hanwha said in a statement it would spend 550 billion won (US$633 million) in total investment this year, against 520 billion won in 1996.
The majority of the investment would go to construction of a new thermal power plant and a middle distillates desulphuriser, it said.
Hanwha also expected 2.33 trillion won in sales from the refining sector, 250 billion won from power generation and 130 billion won from the petrochemical division.
